evaluationSample.eligibility: true path is in primary training-defined candidate inventory and every true operator is supported
evaluationSample.sort: md5('v37-sample|' || canonical_book_code || ':' || chapter || ':' || verse || ':' || token_position) on first token

familyScrambles.mappingRule: within each frozen frequency stratum order identities by md5(salt|codepoint), then rotate only that raw feature family by one position; recompute robust normalization/PCA without Hebrew outcomes

freezeRule: no feature, physical carrier, holdout, support threshold, candidate inventory, smoothing, variance floor, lane weighting, sample, ranking, scramble, ablation, or endpoint changes after hidden-Hebrew V37 outcomes are opened; any change becomes separately labeled robustness or new experiment

holdoutSelection.rankRule: md5('v37-holdout|' || canonical_book_code || ':' || block_index), then canonical_book_code, block_index
holdoutSelection.reason: V30–V35-P whole-book holdouts collectively cover all 39 canonical books; use preregistered contiguous-passage fallback

identityWithinShape.comparison: lane5 exact identity versus categorical identity with each collision pair collapsed to one anonymous category
identityWithinShape.subset: heldout supported paths containing >=1 collision-pair codepoint

lane2.moments: operator-conditioned mean and second moment shrunk alpha=5 toward training-wide state mean/second moment
lane2.name: fine_state
lane2.score: sum across 3 positions of mean per-PC conditional Gaussian log density

lane3.moments: operator-conditioned mean and second moment shrunk alpha=5 toward training-wide state mean/second moment
lane3.name: fine_relational_state
lane3.score: same as lane2 using 10-PC relational representation

lane4.deltaComponent: mean across the 2 adjacent pair-wise mean-PC conditional Gaussian log densities
lane4.deltaTrainingUnit: each distinct adjacent retained-token pair that is consecutive in canonical token order and lies wholly inside a training five-chapter block
lane4.name: ordered_delta
lane4.pairMoments: operator-pair conditioned mean and second moment shrunk alpha=5 toward training-wide delta mean/second moment
lane4.staticComponent: mean across the 3 position-wise mean-PC log densities from lane3

normalization.pca: fit only to visible glyph physical matrix; retain minimum PCs explaining >=95% variance; rescale retained PCs to unit population SD across glyphs

projectionRules.individualOperator: at each position rank supported operators by the lane-specific position emission score; lane4 individual-operator recovery is not defined because delta score is pair-coupled
projectionRules.lemmaPath: project each joint candidate to lemma triple and score projection by maximum joint candidate score
projectionRules.morphologyPath: project each joint candidate to morph triple and score projection by maximum joint candidate score

ranking.frequencySort: training path count descending; candidate path key ascending
ranking.sort: score descending; candidate path key ascending deterministic tie break

shapeScrambles.mappingRule: within each stratum order identities by md5(salt|codepoint), then cyclically rotate physical vectors by one position
shapeScrambles.strataBasis: training-only visible glyph frequency; 5 ordered strata of 6 glyphs

trainingEmissionUnits.candidatePaths: all three-consecutive-retained-token paths inside training five-chapter blocks
trainingEmissionUnits.delta: all consecutive retained-token adjacent pairs inside training five-chapter blocks
trainingEmissionUnits.state: all retained training tokens inside training five-chapter blocks

visibleGlyphUnit.pathRule: three consecutive canonical tokens, each retained; all three must lie in the same five-chapter block and same split side
visibleGlyphUnit.tokenRule: retain tokens carrying exactly one qualifying mark; zero or multiple qualifying marks excluded
